The '''''Book of Sith''''' was a collection of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] historical writings assembled into a single book by [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]. It was bound sometime around [[19 BBY/Legends|19]]-[[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], shortly after the [[Grand Plan/Legends|Grand Plan]] succeeded at [[Clone Wars/Legends|dismantling]] the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|exterminating]] the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], and in placing Sidious in undisputed control of much of [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

The book assembled a group of philosophical and journalistic writings by various [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark siders]] spanning from writings by Palpatine himself, all the way back to the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Second Great Schism]] nearly 7,000 years prior. Besides Sidious, authors included [[Sorzus Syn]] of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|old Sith Empire]], [[Darth Malgus]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], founder of the [[Order of the Sith Lords]] [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] leader [[Talzin/Legends|Mother Talzin]], and Sidious' own master, [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]].

==History==
As a result of [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]], which saw the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple's]] occupants and stewards executed as traitors to the Republic, the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Archives]] were opened to Sidious' exploration. It was in the ruins of the Temple that he uncovered many of these ancient documents, and compiled them into a single volume.<ref name="BOS" />

Each of the documents had marginal notes hand-written by the various people who held them over time. These included [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]], [[Dooku/Legends|Count Dooku]], and [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]. Sidious added his own marginalia after assembling the documents into the book, and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] made his own notes after being made to study the texts by Sidious.<ref name="BOS" />

In [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]], the book was rediscovered by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] amid the ruins of the Emperor's storehouses of [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]] on [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]], after stumbling upon a chamber that, until that year remained hidden.<ref name="BOS" />

Rather than turn it over to the [[Historical Council|New Republic Historical Council]] when he discovered it, Skywalker took the book into his own possession. He feared it may have contained dangerous secrets which could not be made public, and kept it for study before deciding on its fate. Besides Skywalker, the only other individuals aware of his discovery were his wife, former Emperor's Hand Mara Jade Skywalker, and his sister Leia Organa Solo. He did, however, implement page numbers into the text and put them into chronological order for the [[New Republic Intelligence Service]]'s reference, as part of a favor for [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and his wife, [[Iella Wessiri Antilles]] of the NRI wanting to review the book.<ref name="BOS" />

==Sections==
===Sorzus Syn's chronicle===
These pages are from the [[Sorzus Syn's chronicle|chronicle]] of Sorzus Syn, a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] survivor of the Second Great Schism who was among the exiles who first arrived on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] after being exiled from Republic space.<ref name="BOS" />

She details her encounters with and opinions of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Pureblood]] species, her experiments in [[Sith alchemy/Legends|alchemy]], and the origins of the old Sith Empire.<ref name="BOS" />

===Darth Malgus's war journal===
During the Outer Rim campaigns in the opening years of the [[Great Galactic War]], [[Darth Malgus]] kept a [[Journal of Darth Malgus|journal]] to record his thoughts and experiences. These pages recall some of his struggles in the first years of the war.<ref name="BOS" />

===''The Rule of Two''===
''There is only two; one to embody the power, and the other to crave it.''
Some time after the end of the [[New Sith Wars]] and Darth Bane's foundation of the [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]], he collected philosophies that would guide the Sith Order for the next thousand years, entitling his work ''[[The Rule of Two]]''.<ref name="BOS" />

===''Wild Power''===
''[[Wild Power]]'', an instructional manual by Mother Talzin exploring the Nightsisters' use of the dark side and their role as dark side mercenaries in the galaxy.<ref name="BOS" />

===''The Science of Creating Life''===
A [[The Science of Creating Life|scientific journal]] by Darth Plagueis with notes about his experimentation with and manipulation of the Force.<ref name="BOS" />

===''Absolute Power''===
Darth Sidious's manifesto, ''[[Absolute Power]]'', about the philosophy and political manipulation that marked his rise to power and established his [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].<ref name="BOS" />
